title: Finite etale punctured root transitions and their pro-etale limit
statement: Let $p$ be a positive prime, $H$ a commutative ring of characteristic $p$, $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in H$, $r\geq0$, and $f=\prod_i t_i$. For $N_p=\{n>0:(n,p)=1\}$ put $H_n=H[x_i]/(x_i^n-t_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. For $n\mid m$ the map $x_{i,n}\mapsto x_{i,m}^{m/n}$ gives $H_m\cong H_n[y_i]/(y_i^{m/n}-x_{i,n})$. These maps fix coefficients and satisfy the identity and composition laws. The algebras $H_n$ over $H$ and $H_m$ over $H_n$ are finite free of ranks $n^r$ and $(m/n)^r$ respectively, with the corresponding bounded-exponent monomial bases. After localizing at $f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], every level and transition map is finite etale and faithfully flat, hence surjective on spectra [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Set $H_\infty=\varinjlim_{n\in N_p}H_n$. Then $H_\infty[1/f]=\varinjlim_n H_n[1/f]$ and $\operatorname{Spec}H_\infty[1/f]\to\operatorname{Spec}H[1/f]$ is the affine inverse limit of these finite levels and a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on $H$; for $r=0$ or $n=1$ the appropriate level or transition is the identity. Zero localizations are allowed.

proof.text: Use the explicit finite root algebra API: transition maps are the power substitutions, they satisfy identity and composition, the monomial bases have the required product formulas, and refinement is the explicitly constructed iterated quotient equivalence with its transported basis.

Use the actual compatible-root quotient inclusions and its ring colimit universal property. Localize the inclusions and transitions using their constructed lifts; compatibility and structural-map identities follow from the localized-map API. The localized ring colimit property follows by inverting the common coefficient in the original universal property.

Each prime-to-p order is invertible in a characteristic-p ring by invertibleOfCoprime. Apply the localized root API to each level and refinement. Convert the resulting ring-map finiteness and etaleness to the affine scheme properties. Faithful flatness implies spectrum surjectivity.

Use the divisibility wrapper and its universe lift to get a small nonempty directed diagram. Apply the presented-colimit geometry API to the localized universal property and faithfully flat etale level maps. This gives faithful flatness and ind-etaleness of the full structural map and the unique factorization for every test scheme. Surjectivity follows from faithful flatness.

Convert ind-etaleness of the full algebra to weak etaleness of its spectrum map by the etale comparison. The affine spectrum morphism is quasi-compact; together with surjectivity and weak etaleness Scheme.Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage gives exactly the singleton pro-etale covering. The one-level evaluation equivalence and empty-variable equivalences give the two final boundary clauses. Every construction allows zero rings and nilpotent denominators.

proof_origin.place: Explicit finite monic-division and localization constructions, followed by the adopted source filtered-colimit API (090N), spectrum preservation of limits (01YW), and Bhatt--Scholze 4.1.1/4.2.1. The original eleven-step route is retained, with transition etaleness obtained by restriction of scalars between etale levels.
